name: tchopCreateDigest
description: Create a digest post in tchop

properties.name: storyId
properties.description: The ID of the story to create the post in

properties.name: headline
properties.description: Headline shown in the digest (defaults to Title if empty)

properties.name: sourceName
properties.description: Source name to attribute the digest to

properties.name: content
properties.description: The content of the digest in Markdown format
